headline: A marketing stack where every signup, usage event, and deal lands in one governed record, and attribution the CMO can defend.
pitch: I build marketing technology from the tag to the CRM to the warehouse, and I write the code myself. At flyExclusive I own HubSpot Enterprise (every hub) architecture and governance, implemented our tracking in Google Tag Manager, the Meta Pixel and Conversions API, and Google Ads conversion tracking, and set up offline conversion uploads so campaigns optimize on qualified leads and sales rather than form fills. I built the attribution frameworks and dashboards leadership uses, and an LLM pipeline that enriches CRM records and scores leads. I've also consolidated the stack, replacing Tableau and Airtable, and I'm leading the move from HubSpot to an in-house tool. I build with AI every day (Claude Code with MCP servers), so Lightning's audience is one I know.

requirements.need: Own the marketing operations roadmap and tech stack: integrate marketing automation, CRM, data warehouse, and PLG tools
requirements.evidence: At flyExclusive I own the marketing data stack: HubSpot Enterprise, the website and its quoting pipelines into the CRM, tag management, and ad-platform conversion feeds. At TRANZACT I built CRM and ESP integrations with SQL and JSON REST APIs that synced behavioral data into Iterable for 10+ lifecycle campaigns. My warehouse work has been in Databricks and Postgres rather than Snowflake or BigQuery.

requirements.need: Evaluate, buy, implement, and optimize MarTech and vendor relationships
requirements.evidence: I replaced Tableau and Airtable at flyExclusive to consolidate reporting and operational data, and I'm leading the replacement of HubSpot with an internal tool built in-house. I've implemented GTM, Meta CAPI, Google Ads conversion tracking, Stripe Billing, and a Plaid integration.

requirements.need: Data governance, hygiene, privacy compliance (GDPR, CCPA), and enrichment
requirements.evidence: I led flyExclusive's CRM governance (properties, required fields, ownership rules, lifecycle stages), deduplication workflows, identity resolution, and Master Data Management. I built an autonomous LLM enrichment pipeline into the CRM. My live tracker on this site honors Global Privacy Control and Do Not Track and stores no cookies or IP addresses. I haven't owned a formal GDPR program across regions.

requirements.need: Lead routing, scoring models, funnel stages, and SLA tracking with SalesOps and RevOps
requirements.evidence: I designed flyExclusive's lifecycle stages and ownership rules in HubSpot and built a lead-scoring model, powered by LLM enrichment, that prioritizes high-value accounts. As interim manager of the retail sales team (~$10M in monthly sales) I sit on both sides of the marketing-to-sales handoff.

requirements.need: Multi-touch attribution, dashboards, and executive reporting on pipeline and ROI
requirements.evidence: At TRANZACT I ran multi-touch attribution modeling and built measurement and forecasting frameworks for paid media, presented as executive recommendations. At flyExclusive I built the attribution frameworks and leadership dashboards. My case study compares four attribution models, calibrates them with lift tests, and reallocates budget, with an interactive model.

requirements.need: Technical depth in APIs, webhooks, data warehousing, and data governance
requirements.evidence: I write the integrations myself: JSON REST APIs into Iterable at TRANZACT; server-side Conversions API and offline conversion uploads at flyExclusive; on this site, a serverless endpoint that validates events, filters bots, and dedupes on an event ID before writing to Postgres. SQL and Python daily.

requirements.need: Connect product usage data to marketing automation for conversion and expansion; support PLG and sales-assisted motions
requirements.evidence: At TRANZACT I synced behavioral data from the data side into Iterable to drive lifecycle campaigns, which is the same pattern as pushing product-usage events into marketing automation. My work has been sales-assisted (flyExclusive) and direct-to-consumer (TRANZACT); a self-serve PLG funnel would be new, and I'd start by mapping Lightning's signup-to-paid events.

requirements.need: Marketo, Salesforce, Bizible, Snowflake or BigQuery
requirements.evidence: My depth is HubSpot Enterprise, Iterable, Databricks, and Postgres. I haven't run Marketo, Salesforce, or Bizible in production. The data models are the same objects (leads, contacts, accounts, campaigns, touches), and I'd ramp on Lightning's instance first.

requirements.need: Hire, mentor, and lead a team; manage budget; operate across regions; 10+ years
requirements.evidence: I've managed flyExclusive's retail sales team as interim manager since May 2026 and onboarded 10 reps and 5 marketers. I have six years in marketing and data roles, short of ten, and I haven't managed a marketing budget or a multi-region team yet.
